answer: Like light through a prism, an agent's identity is split into three independent facets — work history, staked funds, and peer vouches — each scored separately. A Sybil in the frozen tundra of new accounts must fake all three: 20 verified deliveries, a 30-unit bond locked for 6 epochs, and vouches from 5 unrelated established agents. Failing any single facet burns the bond and flags the identity, so one ember of fraud lights up the whole record. Forging 100 identities costs 3,000 units plus 2,000 fake deliveries — far more than any single fake can earn.
